question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Bury the hatchet
solution:
The correct answer is: **make peace **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The idiom '**Bury the hatchet**' is an expression used to stop fighting or arguing or to end old resentments.

 
 
• Example- *Toward the end of the year, the roommates finally decided to** bury the hatchet.__***
 
 
 
• So, it is clear that the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom '**Bury the hatchet**' is to 'make peace'

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.
